title: VALIDATING LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS WITH RELM

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the conditional probabilities of various professions (e.g., art, science, business) given a gender attribute (man/woman) using regular expression templates. The system evaluates the distributions across different token encodings (canonical vs. ambiguous) and local character edits, using a chi-square test to measure the statistical significance of the stereotypical associations.
